repository_ledger_location.locator_form: kv+intr://KV/02_SKAP_Vault_Ledger (store_type GATEWAY_ENCRYPTED_BLOB: sealed content-addressed blobs at gateway-storage://<gateway_storage_adapter_ref>/02_SKAP_Vault_Ledger/<blob sha256>, append-only head pointer at 02_SKAP_Vault_Ledger/HEAD)
repository_ledger_location.designation_source: KV-SKAP-LEDGER-LOCATION-001 under KV-SKAP-VAULT-FUNCTIONAL-001 (StegVerse-Labs/.github#3324), designated by StegVerse-Labs/continuity-vault-kit: the SKAP Vault ledger ('skap_vault'): layer-2 receipts (stegverse.skap-access-receipt/v1, INTR_KV_SKAP), TV/TVC custody-issuance receipts (stegverse.tvc.skap-custody-reference-issuance/v1, StegVerse-Labs/TVC#537) and custody-result receipts (stegverse.tvc.skap-custody-operation-result/v1). Per StegVerse-org/.github#160 comments 6371986288 (KV is independent of the ecosystem Orgs), 6372045430 (KV only over user-owned storage via a GATEWAY node) and 6372216673 (final: the ledger lives encrypted in the user's storage; cloud storage behind a GATEWAY is an accepted existing dependency): KV keeps its own ledger behind its own InTr endpoint (endpoint_kind KV); it is never stored on any Org ledger ref and KV has no hosted storage of its own. 'repository' KV names the KV endpoint, not a GitHub repository; 'ref' KV_INTR_ENDPOINT names the only access route; 02_SKAP_Vault_Ledger is the ##_<name> storage location inside KV. The backing bytes live, sealed, in the KV user's own storage through a GATEWAY node, bound by .stegverse/kv-gateway/storage-binding.v1.json (gateway_storage_adapter_ref). Same repository_ledger_location keys as StegVerse-org/LLM-adapter#431; new_ledger_root true because this is KV's own ledger root, not a subtree of an Org ledger. This ledger is inside KV and reachable only through KV's InTr (layer 2): a read must carry a layer-1 KV-access receipt minted by KV's InTr ingress. G8 (Coordination provisional ruling, StegVerse-org/.github#167 comment 6372136062): the root key stays in TV/TVC custody; the SKAP Vault holds only wrapped data keys, and unwrapping is a custody transition (receipted here as a custody-operation result), never a ledger read.
repository_ledger_location.initialization: Genesis is a REPOSITORY_LEDGER_INITIALIZATION transition for KV/02_SKAP_Vault_Ledger whose first receipt has previous_receipt_sha256 null, computed by KV on its own side and written as a sealed blob at 02_SKAP_Vault_Ledger in the gateway storage. Not performed by this PR; no ledger is written.
repository_ledger_location.rule: KV computes every receipt of this ledger from its own side. Replay opens the sealed blobs at 02_SKAP_Vault_Ledger, rebuilds the chain from KV's own receipts back to genesis and never reads an Org ledger, the external storage's own records (file ids, owners, revisions, modified times) or 01_KV_Ledger. Correspondence, not storage: an Org/KV interaction is recorded as linked receipts in each side's own ledger (the InTr source half on one side, the ingress half on the other, linked by receipt_sha256); neither ledger is copied across the boundary. Rollback: the head pointer is append-only, the head is signed by a KV_LEDGER_HEAD attester, and a head digest already recorded (an Org correspondence receipt or KV's last verified receipt) must stay on the read-back chain (KV_LEDGER_ROLLBACK_DETECTED). Order lives in KV's ledger, never in a provider's file history.
repository_ledger_location.expected_genesis_note: Null on purpose (pin after observe, StegVerse-org/.github#162 comment 6371352606, here triggered by KV's own InTr ingress, not the org path-transfer): the genesis receipt for KV/02_SKAP_Vault_Ledger cannot be known before it is observed. No digest is invented. The REPOSITORY_LEDGER_GENESIS_PIN transition writes /repository_ledger_location/expected_genesis_receipt_sha256 from the genesis KV reads back; until then every read fails closed KV_LEDGER_GENESIS_NOT_PINNED.

store.adapter_interface: runtime/kv_gateway_storage.py GatewayStorageAdapter (put, get, list, get_head, advance_head)

ledger_designation.append_route: KV_INTR_INGRESS (layer 2: only through KV's InTr, SkapLayer2Gate)
ledger_designation.refuses: Any org designation (store_type GIT_REF, StegVerse-org/.github, refs/stegverse/organization-ledger or any Org ledger ref) is refused for this endpoint: KV_LEDGER_DESIGNATED_ON_ORG_LEDGER.
